home.heroDescription: Build agents that think and act—on their own, or with your team. They plan, talk, and get things done. No hand-holding. No downtime.

home.documentsTitle: Imagine a Teammate Who's Always There, Remembers Everything, and Makes Winning Feel Easy
home.documentsDescription: Meet your personal strategy sidekick—always thinking ahead so you don't have to. No more forgotten details or lost ideas; your project buddy's got perfect memory, letting you focus on the fun stuff. This teammate just gets you, follows your flow, and helps you move fast. With everything out in the open, you're always in the loop, ready to jump in or just watch your team shine. It's teamwork, but way more awesome.
home.howItWorksTitle: Pick a Ready-Made Template or Create Your Own Custom Agent Team From Scratch Today
home.howItWorksDescription: Start your project your way. Choose a template for instant results, or build your own custom squad of agents. Alphii makes it easy, fast, and fun—no tech headaches, just pure creativity.
home.step1Description: Select a template or write your own prompt to build your unique team.
home.step2Description: See your agents think, plan, and collaborate in real time by assigning them, telling them what to do.
home.step3Description: Assign tasks, give feedback, and chat with your team—anytime, anywhere
home.featureTitle: Teammates who are prepped and ready for action, knowing who's good to go
home.pricingTitle: Pay to Power Up Your Workflow and Unlock More Agents When You Need Them
home.pricingDescription: Upgrade your plan and add as many agents as you need, whenever you want. Scale your workflow, unlock new abilities, and get more done.

home.contactEmailText: You can also ask us furtherby emailing to us at:
home.ctaTitle: Are you ready to try Alphii AI now?
home.faq1Answer: Alphii AI is your plug-and-play AI team—agents that build your product like a real dev squad.
home.faq2Answer: Agents coordinate through Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols to make smart decisions and build your product step by step.
home.faq3Answer: Every agent has a role—PM, dev, QA, etc.—and they work together like a synced-up team.
home.faq4Question: Can I build something without knowing how to code?
home.faq4Answer: 100%. Just tell Alphii what you want. Agents handle the rest—planning, coding, testing, and launching.
home.faq5Question: Can I customize how my product is built?
home.faq5Answer: Yes! You can tweak how agents work, guide the process, or let them do their thing. Your product, your way.
